entries.text: Speaker names and living player-list names share a character colour. Names mentioned inside sentences use blue. Character colours do not indicate factions. Underlined action labels identify each statement; reply descriptions name the point being supported or challenged. Role badges: Town green, Antagonist red, Neutral orange. A claim is not proof. Dead players are grey.

Alignment: Town
Action: Investigate one other participant each night and learn their apparent alignment.
Limits: Forger can alter a reading. Ego appears Town. A result is not a secret-role reveal.
Goal: Eliminate all Antagonists and the Serial Killer.
Claim: May truthfully claim Sheriff.

Alignment: Town
Action: Protect one other participant at night.
Limits: Basic protection stops basic attacks, but not a Serial Killer. Applying protection does not prove an attack occurred.
Goal: Eliminate all Antagonists and the Serial Killer.
Claim: May truthfully claim Physician.

Alignment: Town
Action: Use discussion and voting to identify threats.
Limits: No active night ability.
Goal: Eliminate all Antagonists and the Serial Killer.
Claim: Cannot claim a special role or bluff.

Alignment: Town
Action: Shoot one other participant at night, starting on Night 2.
Limits: Three basic shots. Passing or being blocked preserves a shot. Killing a Town participant removes all remaining shots and causes unavoidable guilt death the following night.
Goal: Eliminate all Antagonists and the Serial Killer.
Claim: May truthfully claim Vigilante.

Alignment: Town
Action: Watch another participant and learn who visited them that night.
Limits: See visitor identities, not abilities or the watched participant's outgoing action. A living counterclaimant is a legal target.
Goal: Eliminate all Antagonists and the Serial Killer.
Claim: May truthfully claim Lookout.

Alignment: Antagonist
Action: Carry out the faction's basic night attack.
Limits: One coordinated kill per team per night. Know your teammates. A living player Mafioso controls the target or pass. Cannot attack teammates.
Goal: Secure an Antagonist victory before Ego can steal it.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.

Alignment: Antagonist
Action: Block another participant's night ability.
Limits: Accepted blocks resolve simultaneously. Blocking does not remove passive immunity or prevent scheduled guilt death. Know your teammates.
Goal: Secure an Antagonist victory before Ego can steal it.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.

Alignment: Antagonist
Action: Make one participant appear Antagonist to investigations for that night.
Limits: Changes apparent alignment only; expires the next night and does not change the target's real faction. Know your teammates.
Goal: Secure an Antagonist victory before Ego can steal it.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.

Alignment: Neutral
Action: Make an independent powerful night attack.
Limits: Basic innate defense. No Antagonist teammate knowledge. Cannot kill Ego at night; the two alone form a draw.
Goal: Be the last survivor.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.

Alignment: Neutral
Action: Use discussion and voting to stay alive; no active night ability.
Limits: Immune to night attacks, including while blocked. Can be executed by vote. Appears Town to investigations unless forged.
Goal: Survive until a normal Antagonist victory and replace it. Surviving a Town victory does not win.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.

Alignment: Neutral
Action: Use discussion and voting to draw a day execution; no active night ability.
Limits: A night death does not fulfill the objective. After day execution, choose one living Town participant to kill before night begins.
Goal: Be executed by the day vote.
Claim: May bluff a Town special role.
